Messages.Author: guntherbl
Messages.Body:
Is it possible for the player controlling the acting vampire in a pol.
act. to play another political card from her hand, during the referendum,
to gain one vote (vote pushing) or the political action card used to
promote the referendum already counts as the one she's allowed to
play?

Thank you.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 29 Oct 2000, guntherbl wrote:

> Is it possible for the player controlling the acting vampire in a pol.
> act. to play another political card from her hand, during the referendum,
> to gain one vote (vote pushing) or the political action card used to
> promote the referendum already counts as the one she's allowed to
> play?

If a PA card is used to call the vote, it counts as the vote allowed from
political action cards. (It is a vote, provided by a political action
card.)

If a vote is called by, for instance, the in-built action on Purchase
Pact, a PA can be played from that Methuselahs hand to provide a vote from
a political action card.
